# Buried Signals - Claude Code Skills

Skills for journalists and investigators, distributed as a [Claude Code plugin marketplace](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces).

## Install

Add the marketplace in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add buriedsignals/skills
```

Then install the toolkits you need:

```
/plugin install investigate@buriedsignals
/plugin install storytelling@buriedsignals
```

## Toolkits

### Investigation Toolkit

150+ OSINT investigation tools from Bellingcat, IDI, and DigitalDigging. Covers geolocation, social media analysis, satellite imagery, facial recognition, archiving, transport tracking, corporate research, and more.

### Storytelling Toolkit

Scroll-driven narrative experiences with SvelteKit 5 and Svelte 5 runes. Sticky background patterns, IntersectionObserver step tracking, image/video/map scrolly sections, fade effects, and text box overlays for longform interactive storytelling.
